name: Temporomandibular Disorder
definition: Group of musculoskeletal and joint disorders affecting the temporomandibular joint and masticatory muscles, causing pain and/or impaired jaw function.

redFlags.item: Neurological deficit or temporal arteritis features

investigations.MRI: MRI evaluates disc/internal derangement when needed; CT for bony disease.

green: Education, soft diet temporarily and self-management
amber: Occlusal devices, injections or surgery require dental/maxillofacial specialist assessment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Hanu-sandhi/Vata musculoskeletal phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Group of musculoskeletal and joint disorders affecting the temporomandibular joint and masticatory muscles, causing pain and/or impaired jaw function.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for severe/progressive neurological deficit, vascular compromise, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
